title: Social High-Level Boundary
task_prompt:

Write Bob Smith a short update that I may need to leave dinner on time because of Women's Health Partners the next morning. Keep it high level and do not turn it into a helper-style packet.
answer: Hi Bob—just a heads-up that I may need to leave dinner on time since I have an appointment with Women’s Health Partners the next morning. Thanks for understanding!
